gridlinesToggle.label: Gridlines
gridlinesToggle.description: Toggle whether the lines between rows and columns in the sheet are displayed.

sheetViewToggleGridlinesRows.label: Row Gridlines
sheetViewToggleGridlinesRows.description: Toggle whether the lines between rows in the sheet are displayed.

sheetViewToggleGridlinesColumns.label: Column Gridlines
sheetViewToggleGridlinesColumns.description: Toggle whether the lines between columns in the sheet are displayed.

sheetViewFormatGridlinesColor.label: Gridlines Color
sheetViewFormatGridlinesColor.description: Color the rows and column gridlines.

sheetViewToggleShowHeadings.label: Headings
sheetViewToggleShowHeadings.description: Toggle whether the row and column headings are displayed.

sheetViewToggleShowHeadingRows.label: Row Headings
sheetViewToggleShowHeadingRows.description: Toggle whether the row headings are displayed.

sheetViewToggleShowHeadingColumns.label: Column Headings
sheetViewToggleShowHeadingColumns.description: Toggle whether the column headings are displayed.

sheetViewToggleShowHeadingsNumeric.label: Numeric Headers
sheetViewToggleShowHeadingsNumeric.description: Toggle whether cell headings show numbers or A1 conventions.

sheetViewToggleFormulaView.label: Show Formulas
sheetViewToggleFormulaView.description: Toggle whether cells show formula or values.

sheetViewToggleShowZeros.label: Show Zeros
sheetViewToggleShowZeros.description: Toggle whether cell with zero value shows '0' or blank.

selectAll.label: Select All
selectAll.description: Select the closest data or the entire sheet if no data is nearby.

clearHiddenSelection.label: Select Visible Cells
clearHiddenSelection.description: Break the selection around hidden rows and columns, leaving only the visible cells selected.

formatTextRotate90.label: Rotate Text Down
formatTextRotate90.description: Angle your text so that it aligns with the left.

formatTextRotate270.label: Rotate Text Up
formatTextRotate270.description: Angle your text so that it aligns with the right.

formatTextRotateCustom.label: Custom Text Rotation
formatTextRotateCustom.description: Angle your text using a custom angle.

sortCustom.label: Custom Sort…
sortCustom.description: Choose more options, such as sorting by multiple columns or rows, and case-sensitive sorts.

protectionSheetToggle.label: {locked, select, true{Unprotect Sheet} other{Protect Sheet}}
protectionSheetToggle.description:
Prevent unwanted changes from others by limiting their ability to edit.
For example, you can prevent people from editing locked cells or making formatting changes.

protectionSheetPause.label: {paused, select, true{Resume Protection} other{Pause Protection}}
protectionSheetPause.description:
Temporarily lift protection on this sheet without unprotecting it.
Asks for the sheet password, if there is one. It applies to this session only and is never saved with the file.

protectionHighlightLocked.label: Highlight Locked Cells
protectionHighlightLocked.description:
Shade the cells sheet protection locks, leaving the ranges that stay editable clear.
A view setting: it changes nothing in the workbook, and works whether or not the sheet is protected.

manageProtection.label: Manage Protection
manageProtection.description: Sheet protection and its options, the ranges that stay editable, and workbook protection - in one place.

protectionUnlockRange.label: Unlock Range…
protectionUnlockRange.description: Let the selected cells stay editable while the rest of the sheet is protected.

formatSheetTabColor.label: Tab Color
formatSheetTabColor.description: Color the tab to help differentiate for other sheets.

formatCellStyle.label: Cell Styles
formatCellStyle.description: A colorful style is a great way to make important data stand out on the sheet.

formatTableStyle.label: {hasTable, select, true{Apply Table Style} other{Format as Table}}
formatTableStyle.description: Create a table or apply style to the current table.

formatTableStyleClearCellStyles.label: Format as Table (Clear Styles)
formatTableStyleClearCellStyles.description: Create a table or apply style to the current table and clears all cell styles.

setDefaultTableStyle.label: Set Default Table Style
setDefaultTableStyle.description: Sets the default table style used when a table is inserted.

formatFillColor.label: Fill Color
formatFillColor.description: Color the background of the cells to make them stand out.

formatFontColor.label: Font Color
formatFontColor.description: Change the color of your text.

formatUnderlinedAccountingToggle.label: Accounting Underline
formatUnderlinedAccountingToggle.description: Use accounting underline for the text.

formatUnderlinedAccountingDoubleToggle.label: Double Accounting Underline
formatUnderlinedAccountingDoubleToggle.description: Use accounting double underline the text.

formatSuperscriptToggle.label: Superscript
formatSuperscriptToggle.description: Format your text to be smaller and sit at the top of the line.

formatSubscriptToggle.label: Subscript
formatSubscriptToggle.description: Format your text to be smaller and sit at the bottom of the line.

formatTextOverflowVisibleToggle.label: Overflow Text
formatTextOverflowVisibleToggle.description: Overflow text to the next cells.

formatTextOverflowWrapToggle.label: Wrap Text
formatTextOverflowWrapToggle.description: Wrap text with the existing cell and increase the height as required.

formatTextOverflowClipToggle.label: Clip Text
formatTextOverflowClipToggle.description: Clip text that falls outside of the existing cell.

formatTextOverflowShrinkToggle.label: Shrink Text
formatTextOverflowShrinkToggle.description: Shrink the text font to fit within existing cell.

formatTextOverflowEllipsisToggle.label: Ellipsis Text
formatTextOverflowEllipsisToggle.description: Add a trailing '…' to the text to indicate text is partially hidden.

formatAlignMiddleToggle.label: Align Middle
formatAlignMiddleToggle.description: Align text so that it is centered between the top and bottom of the cell.

formatAlignJustifyVerticalToggle.label: Justify Vertically
formatAlignJustifyVerticalToggle.description: Each 'word' in each line of text inside the cell is evenly distributed across the height of the cell.

formatAlignLeftToggle.label: Align Left
formatAlignLeftToggle.description: Align your content to the left.

formatAlignRightToggle.label: Align Right
formatAlignRightToggle.description: Align your content to the right.

formatAlignCenterContinuousToggle.label: Center Across
formatAlignCenterContinuousToggle.description: Center your content across multiple cells.

formatAlignFillToggle.label: Fill Across
formatAlignFillToggle.description: Repeat the value to fill the entire cell.

formatAlignDistributedHorizontalToggle.label: Distribute Horizontally
formatAlignDistributedHorizontalToggle.description: Each 'word' in each line of text inside the cell is evenly distributed across the width of the cell.

formatFontSizeIncrease.label: Increase Font Size
formatFontSizeIncrease.description: Make your text a bit bigger.

formatFontSizeDecrease.label: Decrease Font Size
formatFontSizeDecrease.description: Make your text a bit smaller.

formatFontSize.label: Font Size
formatFontSize.description: Change the size of your text.

formatCells.label: Format Cells
formatCells.description: Open the Format Cells pane — number, alignment, font, fill and borders.

formatCellsNumber.label: Format Cells: Number
formatCellsNumber.description: Open the Format Cells pane on the Number tab.

formatCellsFont.label: Format Cells: Font
formatCellsFont.description: Open the Format Cells pane on the Font tab.

formatNumberFormat.label: Number Format
formatNumberFormat.description: Choose the format for your cells, such as percentage, currency, date or time.

formatNumberFormatNumberStyle.label: Number Style
formatNumberFormatNumberStyle.description: Format as number with two decimals and comma.

formatNumberFormatTimeStyle.label: Time Style
formatNumberFormatTimeStyle.description: Format as time with hour and minute, and AM or PM.

formatNumberFormatDateStyle.label: Date Style
formatNumberFormatDateStyle.description: Format as date with day, month, and year.

formatNumberFormatAccountingStyle.label: Accounting Style
formatNumberFormatAccountingStyle.description: Format as Dollars, Euros, or other currency.

formatNumberFormatScientificStyle.label: Scientific Style
formatNumberFormatScientificStyle.description: Format as a scientific number with two decimal places .

formatNumberFormatIncreaseDecimal.label: Increase Decimal
formatNumberFormatIncreaseDecimal.description: Show more decimal places for a more precise value.

displayPlaceholdersToggle.label: Display Placeholders
displayPlaceholdersToggle.description: Switch between hiding objects, displaying objects, and displaying placeholders for objects.

displayOutlineSymbolsToggle.label: Display Outline Symbols
displayOutlineSymbolsToggle.description: Display or hide the outline symbols.

calculate.label: Calculate Sheet
calculate.description: Recalculate the formulas on the current sheet.

insertFunctionDialog.label: Insert Function
insertFunctionDialog.description: Work with the function in the current cell.

sheetZoomOut.label: Zoom Out
sheetZoomOut.description: Zoom out to see less detail but more area.

sheetZoomIn.label: Zoom In
sheetZoomIn.description: Zoom in to see more detail but less area.

sheetZoomCustom.label: Custom Zoom
sheetZoomCustom.description: Zoom document to a custom scale.

updateHyperlink.label: Link
updateHyperlink.description: Create a hyperlink to either another webpage or another location within this document.

openHyperlink.label: Open Link
openHyperlink.description: Open the hyperlink or goto another location within this document.

insertNote.label: Insert Note
insertNote.description: Add a note to the cell.

updateComments.label: Comments
updateComments.description: Add a comment to the current cell.

insertImageFromFile.label: Insert Image
insertImageFromFile.description: Insert a picture from your device.

insertImageFromURL.label: Insert Image From Web
insertImageFromURL.description: Insert a picture from the web.

sheetBackgroundToggle.label: Background
sheetBackgroundToggle.description: Add or remove the picture that is tiled behind the sheet's cells.

sheetBackgroundFromFile.label: Sheet Background
sheetBackgroundFromFile.description: Use a picture from your device as the sheet's background.

sheetBackgroundFromURL.label: Sheet Background From Web
sheetBackgroundFromURL.description: Use a picture from the web as the sheet's background.

manageDataValidation.label: Data Validation
manageDataValidation.description: Manage data validation rules to limit the type of data entered in a cell.

manageConditionalFormat.label: Conditional Formatting
manageConditionalFormat.description: Manage conditional formatting rules to change how cells look based on their values.

conditionalFormatNewRule.label: New Conditional Formatting Rule
conditionalFormatNewRule.description: Create a new conditional formatting rule for the selected cells.

conditionalFormatGreaterThan.label: Highlight Cells Greater Than
conditionalFormatGreaterThan.description: Highlight cells whose value is greater than a value you set.

conditionalFormatLessThan.label: Highlight Cells Less Than
conditionalFormatLessThan.description: Highlight cells whose value is less than a value you set.

conditionalFormatBetween.label: Highlight Cells Between
conditionalFormatBetween.description: Highlight cells whose value is between two values you set.

conditionalFormatEqualTo.label: Highlight Cells Equal To
conditionalFormatEqualTo.description: Highlight cells whose value equals a value you set.

conditionalFormatTextContains.label: Highlight Cells with Text that Contains
conditionalFormatTextContains.description: Highlight cells whose text contains a value you set.

conditionalFormatDateOccurring.label: Highlight Cells with a Date Occurring
conditionalFormatDateOccurring.description: Highlight cells whose date falls in a period you set.

conditionalFormatDuplicateValues.label: Highlight Duplicate Values
conditionalFormatDuplicateValues.description: Highlight cells whose value appears more than once in the selection.

conditionalFormatTopItems.label: Highlight Top 10 Items
conditionalFormatTopItems.description: Highlight the highest-ranked values in the selection.

conditionalFormatTopPercent.label: Highlight Top 10%
conditionalFormatTopPercent.description: Highlight the top percentage of values in the selection.

conditionalFormatBottomItems.label: Highlight Bottom 10 Items
conditionalFormatBottomItems.description: Highlight the lowest-ranked values in the selection.

conditionalFormatBottomPercent.label: Highlight Bottom 10%
conditionalFormatBottomPercent.description: Highlight the bottom percentage of values in the selection.

conditionalFormatAboveAverage.label: Highlight Above Average
conditionalFormatAboveAverage.description: Highlight values above the average of the selection.

conditionalFormatBelowAverage.label: Highlight Below Average
conditionalFormatBelowAverage.description: Highlight values below the average of the selection.

conditionalFormatDataBar.label: Data Bars
conditionalFormatDataBar.description: Add a colored bar to each cell whose length represents its value.

conditionalFormatColorScale.label: Color Scales
conditionalFormatColorScale.description: Color each cell along a gradient according to its value.

conditionalFormatIconSet.label: Icon Sets
conditionalFormatIconSet.description: Show an icon in each cell according to its value.

conditionalFormatClearSelection.label: Clear Rules from Selected Cells
conditionalFormatClearSelection.description: Remove the conditional formatting rules that touch the selected cells.

conditionalFormatClearSheet.label: Clear Rules from Entire Sheet
conditionalFormatClearSheet.description: Remove every conditional formatting rule on this sheet.

manageProtectedRange.label: Allow Edit Ranges
manageProtectedRange.description: Manage ranges that stay editable while the sheet is protected.

dataRemoveDuplicates.label: Remove Duplicates
dataRemoveDuplicates.description: Remove duplicate rows from a sheet.

dataTextToColumns.label: Text to Columns
dataTextToColumns.description: Split a single columns of text into multiple columns.

insertTable.label: Insert Table
insertTable.description: Create a table. Tables enable auto formatting, sorting, filtering, and other advanced features.

editTable.label: Edit Table…
editTable.description: Edit the table to adjust formatting, sorting, filtering, or other advanced features.

deleteTable.label: Delete Table
deleteTable.description:
Remove the table.

The table and table specific styling will be removed but the values will be preserved.

convertTableToRange.label: Convert To Range
convertTableToRange.description:
Convert the table into a normal range  of cells.

The values and the formatting are preserved.

formatPainterToggle.label: Format Painter
formatPainterToggle.description: Apply style to another part of your workbook.

fillDown.label: Fill Down
fillDown.description: Copy the top-most value from the selection to the bottom of the selection.

fillRight.label: Fill Right
fillRight.description: Copy the left-most value from the selection to the right of the selection.

fillUp.label: Fill Up
fillUp.description: Copy the bottom-most value from the selection to the top of the selection.

fillLeft.label: Fill Left
fillLeft.description: Copy the right-most value from the selection to the left of the selection.

fillSeries.label: Series…
fillSeries.description: Fill the selection with a series of numbers or dates, choosing the type, step value and stop value.

formatIndentDecrease.label: Decrease Indent
formatIndentDecrease.description: Move your content closer to the border.

formatIndentIncrease.label: Increase Indent
formatIndentIncrease.description: Move your content further from the border.

mergeToggle.label: Merge
mergeToggle.description: Combine and center the contents into a single cell.

mergeHorizontal.label: Merge Horizontally
mergeHorizontal.description: Combine the contents into horizontal rows.

mergeVertical.label: Merge Vertically
mergeVertical.description: Combine the contents into vertical columns.

unmerge.label: Unmerge
unmerge.description: Split merged cells into multiple cells.

clearContents.label: Clear Contents
clearContents.description:
Clear only the contents in the cells.

The formatting is not cleared.

clearFormats.label: Clear Formats
clearFormats.description: Clear only the formatting that is applied to the cells.

clearHyperlinks.label: Clear Hyperlinks
clearHyperlinks.description: Clear only the hyperlinks in the cells.

clearComments.label: Clear Comments
clearComments.description: Clear the comments from the cells.

clearAll.label: Clear All
clearAll.description:
Clears everything from the cells.

All contents and formatting are removed.

freezeToggle.label: Freeze Panes
freezeToggle.description: Keep rows and columns visible while the rest of the sheet scrolls (based on current selection).

freezeToggleHorizontal.label: Freeze Top Rows
freezeToggleHorizontal.description: Keep the top rows visible while scrolling through the rest of the sheet.

freezeToggleVertical.label: Freeze Left Columns
freezeToggleVertical.description: Keep the left columns visible while scrolling through the rest of the sheet.

unfreeze.label: Unfreeze Panes
unfreeze.description: Unfreeze both the rows and columns.

autoFitRows.label: Autofit Rows
autoFitRows.description: Adjust the rows to the best height.

resizeRows.label: Resize Rows
resizeRows.description: Resize the rows to the specified height.

autoFitColumns.label: Autofit Columns
autoFitColumns.description: Adjust the columns to the best width.

resizeColumns.label: Resize Columns
resizeColumns.description: Resize the columns to the specified width.

pasteValues.label: Paste Values
pasteValues.description:
Paste only the values of the selected cells.

The formatting is not applied.

pasteFormats.label: Paste Formatting
pasteFormats.description:
Paste only the formats of the selected cells.

The content is not applied.

pasteFormulas.label: Paste Formulas
pasteFormulas.description: Paste only the formulas of the selected cells. The values and formatting is not applied.

pasteTranspose.label: Paste Transpose
pasteTranspose.description: Paste with the rows and columns flipped.

pasteLinks.label: Paste Links
pasteLinks.description: Paste as formula references to the original cells.
